description: DA-03/DA-04/DA-05 ingest pipeline: unstructured internal documents (docx/pdf/xlsx/html/slack threads) into governed knowledge cards — incremental sync_source change-listing (watermark store), parse/normalize/dedup capture-transforms, plus the explicit ingest:commit ceremony (Hybrid Sovereign Ledger asset records, supersede, staleness detection)

capabilities.description: DA-03 incremental sync: reads the tenant × source watermark (active/shared/runtime/ingest-cursors/), lists changed items from box/slack/confluence read presets, and advances the watermark only after a fully successful listing (at-least-once; mid-fetch failure records consecutive_failures without moving the cursor)
Parses docx/pdf/xlsx/html/slack_thread/markdown/text input into the unified ingest intermediate representation with a raw-bytes content_sha256
Derives tenant-aware target path and schema-validated knowledge-card frontmatter from an ingest IR; fails closed when required keys cannot be derived
Checks and registers content hashes in the ingest registry; same-source different-hash re-ingests are reported as supersede candidates
Side-effect-free comparison of the tenant asset ledger against a caller-supplied current-source listing; lists active assets and flags content-hash/source-version drift

DA-05 explicit ingest ceremony: lands a normalized knowledge card inside the tenant knowledge root (fail-closed path guard, ingest_commit authority role) and appends the append-only asset ledger record; re-ingests of the same source become supersede versions
